title: The same board read into the board model
how: Layers 1, 16, 20 and 21 all have a meaning, so 4 layers, 2 of them copper; 2 packages (R0805, PIN2) with 2 pads each;
3 elements, none mirrored; 2 pads each so 6 placed pads; 2 signals;
contactrefs R1.2, J1.1, R1.1 and R2.1 all name a pad of their package, so 4 pad nets;
the two GND wires on layer 1 share the point (14, 10) and one width, so they join into one track of 2 pieces; the SIG wire is a track of 1 piece: 2 tracks, 3 pieces;
1 via; the wire on layer 21 is 1 silkscreen stroke; the four wires on layer 20 close a ring, so 4 outline points.
